description: Test file for system prompt cache boundary helper functions, testing splitting, stripping, and prepending prompt text around a boundary marker.

methods.name: splitSystemPromptCacheBoundary
methods.description: Splits a prompt string into stable prefix and dynamic suffix based on a cache boundary marker.

methods.name: stripSystemPromptCacheBoundary
methods.description: Removes the internal boundary marker from prompt text and returns a cleaned string.

methods.name: prependSystemPromptAdditionAfterCacheBoundary
methods.description: Inserts a prompt addition after the cache boundary marker, normalizing whitespace.
